headline: Claude Code: Explain Changes in Plain Words
summary: Anthropic introduces a natural-language explanation feature in Claude Code that translates code diffs into human-readable summaries. This reduces cognitive load during code review and onboarding by letting developers ask 'why' directly in their IDE.

slides.title: Ever Stared at a Diff and Wondered "Why?"
slides.subtitle: Claude Code now explains its own changes in plain English.
slides.body: Code reviews often stall when intent isn't clear. Developers waste time deciphering terse commit messages or cryptic diffs. What if the AI that wrote the code could also explain it like a senior teammate?
slides.deep_dive: Modern AI coding assistants generate vast amounts of code, but the explanation layer has been missing. Engineers still manually annotate PRs, write changelogs, or schedule sync meetings to convey intent. This feature closes that loop by embedding explanation directly into the generation workflow, turning every change into a self-documenting artifact.
slides.key_fact: Claude Code can now articulate the reasoning behind its edits in natural language on demand.
slides.why_it_matters: Reduces review cycles, accelerates onboarding, and preserves institutional knowledge without extra documentation effort.

slides.title: Ask "Explain This Change" Right in Your Editor
slides.subtitle: No context switching — explanation lives where you code.
slides.body: Invoke via slash command or context menu. Works on any diff: refactors, bug fixes, new features. Integrates with VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI. Zero config for most repos.

slides.title: From Diff to Narrative in Seconds
slides.subtitle: How the explanation engine processes your changes.
slides.body: The agent analyzes the structured diff, correlates with repository context, and synthesizes a human-readable rationale.

slides.title: Developer Query → Structured Explanation
slides.subtitle: Input, processing, and output stages demystified.
slides.body: Treat the explanation as a first-class artifact you can search, share, and version.
slides.input: Natural language prompt (e.g., "Why did you rename this function?") or implicit via diff selection.
slides.processing: AST-aware diff parsing → semantic change classification → context retrieval → LLM prompt construction → streaming response.
slides.output: Markdown-formatted explanation with code references, linked symbols, and optional follow-up questions.

slides.title: Get Better Explanations, Avoid Common Traps
slides.subtitle: Treat the AI like a junior dev — guide it with context.
slides.body: Explanation quality depends on repository hygiene and prompt clarity.
items: ✅ Keep commit history meaningful — AI uses it for context
✅ Ask specific questions ("Why this algorithm?") not vague ones
✅ Use for onboarding: generate explanations for legacy modules
❌ Don't trust blindly — verify critical logic changes manually
❌ Avoid on massive diffs (>500 lines) — break into smaller changes
❌ Don't skip writing tests — explanations complement, not replace, verification

slides.title: Enable Explanations in Your Workflow Today
slides.subtitle: Install, configure, and start asking "why" in minutes.
slides.body: Available now in Claude Code extension. No API key required for basic usage.
takeaways: Configure: Set explanation verbosity in settings.json
Habit: Add "Explain change" to your PR template checklist
